question: Who among the following was the youngest umpire to enter the ICC Elite Panel in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nitin Menon**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nitin Menon was the youngest umpire to enter the ICC Elite Panel in 2020.**
 
• Indian umpire Nitin Menon has been **included in the International Cricket Council's elite panel of umpires.**
 
• He was included in **the elite panel for the 2020-21 season.**
 
• He replaced **England umpire, Nigel Long.**
 
• Nitin Menon was earlier **part of the Emirates ICC International Panel of Umpires.**
 
• He has experience umpiring in **three Tests, 24 One Day Internationals and 16 T20 Internationals.**
 
• Nitin Menon is **the third Indian after former captain Srinivas Venkataraghavan and Sundaram Ravi to make it to the prestigious panel.**
 
• Nitin Menon has been inducted by** a selection panel comprising ICC General Manager (Cricket) Geoff Allardyce (Chairman), Indian commentator Sanjay Manjrekar and matches referees Ranjan Madugalle and David Boon.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Aleem Dar**

 
 
• **​**Aleem Dar is **a Pakistani cricket umpire and former cricketer.**
 
 
 
• **Sundaram Ravi**
 
 
• **​**Sundaram Ravi is **an Indian cricket umpire who was a member of the ICC Elite Panel of Umpires between 2015 and 2019.**
 
 
 
• **Nigel Llong**
 
 
• **​**Nigel James Long is** an English cricket umpire and former first-class cricketer.**
